purpose: Five Realms five boss modeling and attack/VFX concept sheets

prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Professional Blender modeling concept sheet for one boss in FIVE REALMS low-poly 2.5D platformer. Chunky charming fantasy, clean readable silhouettes, restrained cel-like material regions and broad facets, no photorealism or noisy textures, no horror/gore, restrained emission. Neutral cream-white background, spacious production layout, consistent model shape across views. Main top row aligned large FRONT / SIDE / BACK orthographic neutral views on same baseline and scale, entire body visible with nothing cropped. Bottom row: one polished 3/4 view; separated model parts; small STUNNED pose and close-up of top-of-head WeakPoint. Clear short labels, no fake dense specifications. Floating weakpoint indicator is a diagram only, not an extra body object.
Header 'SPROUT KING / WORLD 1 / MODEL SHEET'.
Preserve the supplied existing Sprout King character identity: round green plant king, oversized oval white-and-black eyes and expressive brows, tiny mouth with two small fangs, EXACTLY TWO short arms with cream mitten hands, TWO brown root-like shoes, pale cream lower belly band, dark green layered-leaf cape, gold circlet with pink-red gem and two broad sprout leaves rising from crown. NO treant trunk redesign, no extra legs. Refine into clear low-poly cel-shaded modeling art. Total visual height around3.5m; body collider reference2.6m wide. Separate Body/Face/Arm_L/R/Foot_L/R/Cape/Crown/Gem/Stem/Leaf_L/R. WeakPoint at top of head at sprout base, accessible from above and not blocked by sharp leaves. STUNNED lowers body and droops sprout, crown gem glows pink-gold; crown and leaves remain attached.

Use case: stylized-concept. A clean Blender/game-animation production sheet, warm-white background, matching the attached boss's EXACT design, proportions, parts, palette, anatomy and top-of-head weakpoint. Header names the boss and 'PATTERNS & FX'. Upper area has THREE rows of attack storyboards, each THREE columns TELEGRAPH / ATTACK / RECOVER. Use side-on gameplay pose views, clear flat ground baseline, compact directional arrows and simple hazard shapes; don't obscure boss body. Every row ends in a clearly lowered, stunned posture with weakpoint exposed and exactly three tiny orbiting gold stars. Telegraph markers are dashed outlines; active hazards solid shapes; recovery has no damaging VFX. Bottom area has SIX separated FX component tiles labeled FX01..FX06 with isolated mesh/particle pieces. No dense prose or invented stats, no full scenery. This is a concept storyboard NOT an alpha sprite atlas, no UI mockup. All proposed attack designs correspond to Charge / Slam / Rain framework categories.
Boss: SPROUT KING / WORLD 1.
P01 SPROUT CHARGE: lowers sprout and winds up with leaf flutter; body rushes horizontally with dust/leaf trail toward a low stone arena wall; hits wall and sits dazed. P02 ROOT STOMP: lifts both short arms and one foot; foot/body stomp sends TWO low earth/leaf shockwaves left/right; slumps exposing sprout-base weakpoint. P03 ACORN RAIN: shakes leaf cape and crown, three separated circular ground warning markers; THREE chunky acorns fall onto marked spots leaving safe gaps, cape shake then stops; stunned pose. FX01 pink/gold dashed warning ring, FX02 green leaf ribbon and dust puff, FX03 low earth wave mesh with leaves, FX04 low-poly acorn with separate cap and small impact chips, FX05 three gold stars + pink crown glow, FX06 dissolving green leaves and warm seed glints (no gore).
